## Handoff to Dharm (Sat 22:30): Shweta asked Dharm to take the rest
**Built and on main (this push):**
- **Finger tracking** (`src/motion/hands.ts`, MediaPipe Hand Landmarker, model in `public/models/hand_landmarker.task`): per hand ✋ open / ☝️ point / ✊ fist + tilt. Rule everywhere: an open hand never selects; point-and-hold fills the ring; closing a fist ON a target selects at once; while the hand tracker loads nothing is selected. New bus events `grab` / `release` (side). Cursor shows the shape. Unit-tested (`tests/gestures.test.ts`).
- **`/play/lab`** (the new lab experience, separate from the worksheet game): 3D building → speech bubble over the student "Which one do you want to learn today?" (Organic / Inorganic / Acids & Bases / Physical = soon) → he auto-walks to that room → "Ready for questions?" → hands-on lessons at a bench → back for the next subject.
  - **Molecule Builder** (`src/game/lab/MoleculeBuilder.tsx`, rules in `src/game/molecules.ts`): grab atoms with a fist, drop in the ring; code counts atoms (`parseFormula`), wrong element / too many explained, right set snaps into the shape. CH4, C2H6, CH3OH, H2O, NH3, CO2.
  - **Pour Lab** (`src/game/lab/PourLab.tsx`, lessons in `src/game/lab/lessons.ts`): fist on a beaker, hold over the flask, tilt to pour (visible stream, flask fills) → precipitate / colour / bubbles → explanation card. Equations atom-checked in tests.
  - These lessons are LOCAL (not worksheet questions): they don't post attempts yet.
- **Lab building** (`src/three/lab/*`): 17 Meshy GLB models in `public/models/lab` (~40 MB, worth compressing), rotate (drag / Q·E), zoom, WASD, auto-walk. In the worksheet game it's opt-in: `/play/<wsId>?world=1`.
- **Mix Lab:** grab + tilt-to-pour replaces clap when finger tracking is on (keyboard C still works).

**Not built by Shweta (yours now):** R-P2-1 Titration Lab, R-P2-2 Mystery Sample, R-P2-3 Reaction Yield Lab + "everything on the bench / no balloons" from LAB-SPEC. ## Notes for the partner
- **Play URL:** `/play/<wsId>` (e.g. `/play/fixture`). Uses only `@/lib/client/api` + `@/lib/speak`; classCode = `getClassCode() ?? "TEST"`. Ends with `endSession` → `/results/<sessionId>`.
- **At lock-in** the game calls `postAttempt(a)` and `nextStep({ sessionId, attemptId: null, attempt: a })` together, as your note asked. On `N` (skip) it calls `nextStep({ sessionId })` with no attempt; the game keeps its own played list and never replays a worksheet question, so the real `/api/next` may return an already-played id safely.
- **Attempt fields:** `input` is honest (`gesture` / `keyboard` / `mouse`); `hoverTrace` is `{choice, ms}` from cursor or mouse hover ≥ 150 ms; `msToAnswer` excludes paused time.
- **Bus (Shweta-internal):** besides the 8 gesture types there's a `command` event for keyboard-only controls (pick 1–4, skip, pause, debug, trace, angle, power).
- **FYI, bundle:** `api.ts` imports `fallbackNext` from `agents/director`, which pulls `assemble` + mathjs into the Play page's client bundle. Not blocking; maybe worth splitting when you switch to real fetch.
- **Attempts now carry** `experiments[]` (Launcher: `{thetaDeg, speed, landedM}`, code-computed) and `mixTries[]` (Mix Lab pairs, formulas as in the worksheet).
- **Mix Lab wording:** a wrong pair says "Not the pair for this experiment. Try again." (05 §3), not the task file's "No visible reaction": that pair was never verified.
- **Launcher field** follows 05 §2 (v²/g rounded up to 10 m, min 50 m) rather than a fixed 100 m, so a 35 m shot uses most of the screen.
- **Balancer (q4):** attempt `chosen` is the matching choice when the coefficients equal a choice's text, else `"X"` with `chosenText` = the coefficient list and `misconceptionId` = `unbalanced_<element>` only if that id is in the worksheet registry. `balancerSteps` = every coefficient list the student made (last 30).
- **AI trace drawer (T):** shows exactly what `nextStep` returns: `source`, `ms`, `reason`, `feedback`, `rejected[]`. Please keep `reason` one line and put code rejections in `rejected[]`; the drawer labels them "Code caught it".
- **Gesture thresholds changed (from Shweta's recorded clips):** both-hands-up now needs wrists 0.4·sw above the nose (was 0.2: it fired on a 60° aim and on head dips while clapping); clap closes at 0.4·sw (was 0.35: missed a real clap). All 13 clips + negatives pass.
- **Keys added:** `X` = Balancer subscript trap (a new `command` "subscript" on the bus).
- **Offline:** the arena doesn't use `<Environment preset="city">` (it downloads an HDR from a CDN); it lights with Lightformers instead.
